items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And then Sammy Williams came in and he played the organ for years in there.

ctx.x: Yeah, right, right, yeah, right. Well, to a certain extent. See, it's like I say. You could categorize it like that, but there wasn't that much. Like, the Regal Theatre, now, they had a band. They had about a 12-piece band there. And maybe they would augment for particular shows or something. Dave Peyton was there with his -- he was the musical director. Then they had Sammy -- well, Fats Waller played there, played the organ.
And then Sammy Williams came in and he played the organ for years in there. And there, and then across the street, Sammy Stewart at one time played for the Metropolitan Theatre.
